_basePathNote: Leave empty for a custom domain (the intended setup). Set to "/OceanAstra-Website" only if the site is served from a GitHub project-pages subpath.
_legalNameNote: The licence prints the name in capitals (OCEANASTRA TECHNOLOGIES L.L.C). Rendered here in title case, which is word-for-word identical and reads correctly in running text.
_emailNote: Three published addresses, all live on Lark Mail. `general` carries enquiries, sales and all legal/privacy correspondence; `support` carries service support for clients and application users, and is the App Store support contact; `partners` carries partnership and vendor-integration enquiries.
